Label glyphs (MapLibre PBF signed-distance-field ranges) for "Noto Sans Regular" and "Noto Sans Medium".
Ranges 0-255 and 256-511 fetched 23 Nov 2026 from https://protomaps.github.io/basemaps-assets/fonts/ .
Range 8192-8447 is made locally (lane b05): only the en dash and em dash, copied from the hyphen glyph, so road
names with dashes draw without a request to a missing file.
